caption:
The Arthur M. Bueche Award has existed for over four decades. No Indian American had ever won it - until now.

Sethuraman Panchanathan, born in Chennai, is the National Academy of Engineering's 2026 Bueche Award recipient - the first Indian American to receive it. He served as the 15th Director of the US National Science Foundation, including funding COVID-19 vaccine research, and oversaw NSF's first new directorate in over 30 years. Now a University Professor at Arizona State University, he'll receive the award October 4, 2026 in Washington, D.C.

This isn't a research grant or a single discovery. It's recognition for shaping how an entire country decided what science to fund.

Sources: ASU News, American Bazaar (2026)
